title: 'Not the right time' - Fernandes pauses Man Utd contract talks
description: Manchester United captain Bruno Fernandes says he has been offered a new contract by the club but feels it "is not the right time" for discussions about his future.

title: Leeds dominate Chelsea for first Stamford Bridge win since 1999
description: Noah Okafor scores twice to deliver Leeds United's first win at Chelsea in 27 years, in an impressive 4-1 victory at Stamford Bridge. Daniel Farke's side move up to sixth in the Premier League.

title: Arsenal go six points clear after lively draw at Newcastle
description: Noni Madueke's second-half goal earns Arsenal a 2-2 draw against Newcastle United at St James' Park, as the reigning champions move six points clear at the top of the Premier League table.

title: Coventry beat Palace in Frank's first game after late own goal
description: A Dwight McNeil own goal in the 85th minute gives Coventry City a 3-2 win to move three points clear of the relegation zone, as Thomas Frank's first game in charge at Crystal Palace ends in defeat in the Premier League.

title: AC Milan monitoring Man Utd's Fernandes - Sunday's gossip
description: AC Milan monitoring Manchester United midfielder Bruno Fernandes, Arsenal pair yet to start talks on new deals and Trabzonspor renew interest in Tottenham forward Richarlison, plus more.

title: 'It's a deserved defeat' - Glasner on  Bournemouth loss
description: Nottingham Forest manager Oliver Glasner believes his side "deserved" to lose against Bournemouth as a 2-0 defeat leaves them above the drop zone on goal difference.

title: Fifpro criticises Bayern Munich for Musiala comments
description: Football players' union Fifpro says it is concerned by German club Bayern Munich's comments about Jamal Musiala's contract.

title: All done deals from September-November 2026
description: Check out the significant signings and departures in the Premier League, Scottish Premiership, EFL and Women's Super League.

title: Were any current Man City players signed during charges period?
description: BBC Sport's Ask Me Anything team looks at whether any Manchester City players were signed during the time the club have been found guilty of breaching the Premier League's financial rules.

title: Armstrong plays down talk of Rangers transfer - gossip
description: Dinamo Bucharest winger Danny Armstrong says he has not talked with Rangers manager Derek McInnes about a move to Ibrox, while the chances of Jack Grealish joining Celtic are played down.

title: Arsenal had more than 20 players on shortlist to capitalise on title win
description: Senior football correspondent Sami Mokbel goes inside Arsenal's bid to capitalise on their Premier League title and strengthen their squad this summer.

title: Life as a Wag in the transfer window
description: What is life like for footballers' families during the transfer window where a last-minute deal means you need to uproot your life and move hundreds of miles?
